product_direction.primary_identity: A daily Bhagavad Gita practice app
product_direction.secondary_feature: Scripture-first chat companion for personal guidance
core_value: Return every day for a verse, reflection, and small practice
Learn the Gita gradually through verse cards and review
Use chat only when specific guidance is needed

gita_basics.setting: Dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna on the battlefield of Kurukshetra
gita_basics.larger_text: Part of the Mahabharata, Bhishma Parva

daily_habit_loop: Answer or sit with one reflection prompt
Optionally continue into Learn or Chat

starter_verse_pack.sanskrit: देहिनोऽस्मिन्यथा देहे कौमारं यौवनं जरा। तथा देहान्तरप्राप्तिर्धीरस्तत्र न मुह्यति।।2.13।।
starter_verse_pack.transliteration: dehino ’smin yathā dehe kaumāraṁ yauvanaṁ jarā; tathā dehāntara-prāptir dhīras tatra na muhyati.
starter_verse_pack.translation_plain: Just as the embodied self passes through childhood, youth, and old age in this life, it also passes on to another state; the steady one is not deluded by this.
starter_verse_pack.daily_reflection: What change in life am I resisting as though it should not exist?
starter_verse_pack.tiny_practice: Name one change you are facing, then sit with it for one quiet minute without trying to fix it.

starter_verse_pack.transliteration: mātrā-sparśās tu kaunteya śītoṣṇa-sukha-duḥkha-dāḥ; āgamāpāyino ’nityās tāṁs titikṣasva bhārata.
starter_verse_pack.translation_plain: Sensations of heat and cold, pleasure and pain, come and go; they are temporary. Learn to bear them steadily.
starter_verse_pack.daily_reflection: What feeling today am I treating as permanent even though it is passing?
starter_verse_pack.tiny_practice: When discomfort rises today, say inwardly: this too comes and goes.

starter_verse_pack.sanskrit: कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन। मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि।।2.47।।
starter_verse_pack.transliteration: karmaṇy evādhikāras te mā phaleṣu kadācana; mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo ’stv akarmaṇi.
starter_verse_pack.translation_plain: Your right is to action alone, never to its fruits. Do not make the fruits of action your motive, and do not fall into inaction.
starter_verse_pack.daily_reflection: Where am I confusing my worth with the result of my effort?
starter_verse_pack.tiny_practice: Choose one task today and do it fully without checking whether it is paying off.

starter_verse_pack.sanskrit: तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर। असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः।।3.19।।
starter_verse_pack.transliteration: tasmād asaktaḥ satataṁ kāryaṁ karma samācara; asakto hy ācaran karma param āpnoti pūruṣaḥ.
starter_verse_pack.translation_plain: Therefore, always perform the work that ought to be done without attachment; by acting without attachment, a person reaches the highest.
starter_verse_pack.daily_reflection: What necessary action am I avoiding because I want certainty first?
starter_verse_pack.tiny_practice: Do one needed task today before asking whether you feel like it.

starter_verse_pack.sanskrit: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्। स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः।।3.35।।
starter_verse_pack.transliteration: śreyān sva-dharmo viguṇaḥ para-dharmāt sv-anuṣṭhitāt; sva-dharme nidhanaṁ śreyaḥ para-dharmo bhayāvahaḥ.
starter_verse_pack.translation_plain: Better one’s own path, even imperfectly lived, than another’s path done well. Better to live and die in one’s own duty; another’s path is dangerous.
starter_verse_pack.daily_reflection: Where am I abandoning my own path because someone else’s seems more impressive?
starter_verse_pack.tiny_practice: Write down one responsibility that is truly yours and return to it today.

starter_verse_pack.sanskrit: युक्तः कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिमाप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम्। अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते।।5.12।।
starter_verse_pack.transliteration: yuktaḥ karma-phalaṁ tyaktvā śāntim āpnoti naiṣṭhikīm; ayuktaḥ kāma-kāreṇa phale sakto nibadhyate.
starter_verse_pack.translation_plain: The integrated person, giving up attachment to the fruits of action, attains peace. The unsteady person, attached to results and driven by desire, becomes bound.
starter_verse_pack.daily_reflection: What desire for recognition or reward is disturbing my peace?
starter_verse_pack.tiny_practice: Do one piece of work quietly today without announcing it or measuring its reward.

starter_verse_pack.sanskrit: उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्। आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः।।6.5।।
starter_verse_pack.transliteration: uddhared ātmanātmānaṁ nātmānam avasādayet; ātmaiva hy ātmano bandhur ātmaiva ripur ātmanaḥ.
starter_verse_pack.translation_plain: Let a person lift oneself by oneself; let one not sink oneself. The self can be one’s friend, and the self can be one’s enemy.
starter_verse_pack.daily_reflection: Am I treating myself today like an ally or like an enemy?
starter_verse_pack.tiny_practice: Take one small action today that clearly helps your future self.

starter_verse_pack.sanskrit: बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः। अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत्।।6.6।।
starter_verse_pack.transliteration: bandhur ātmātmanas tasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ; anātmanas tu śatrutve vartetātmaiva śatru-vat.
starter_verse_pack.translation_plain: For one who has mastered oneself, the self is a friend; for one who has not, the self behaves like an enemy.
starter_verse_pack.daily_reflection: What pattern in me keeps acting like an enemy right now?
starter_verse_pack.tiny_practice: Notice one repeating self-defeating pattern today and interrupt it once.

starter_verse_pack.sanskrit: यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम्। ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्।।6.26।।
starter_verse_pack.transliteration: yato yato niścarati manaś cañcalam asthiram; tatas tato niyamyaitad ātmany eva vaśaṁ nayet.
starter_verse_pack.translation_plain: Wherever the restless, unsteady mind wanders, bring it back under discipline and return it to the self.
starter_verse_pack.daily_reflection: Where does my mind go when I am trying to stay steady?
starter_verse_pack.tiny_practice: Each time your mind wanders today, bring it back gently once without irritation.

starter_verse_pack.transliteration: śreyo hi jñānam abhyāsāj jñānād dhyānaṁ viśiṣyate; dhyānāt karma-phala-tyāgas tyāgāc chāntir anantaram.
starter_verse_pack.translation_plain: Knowledge is better than mere practice, meditation is better than knowledge, and giving up the fruits of action is better than meditation; from such renunciation, peace follows immediately.
starter_verse_pack.daily_reflection: What would I need to let go of to experience a little more peace today?
starter_verse_pack.tiny_practice: Release one small expectation today and notice whether your mind softens.

starter_verse_pack.sanskrit: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च। निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी।।12.13।।
starter_verse_pack.transliteration: adveṣṭā sarva-bhūtānāṁ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca; nirmamo nirahaṅkāraḥ sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ kṣamī.
starter_verse_pack.translation_plain: One who has no hatred toward any being, who is friendly and compassionate, free from possessiveness and ego, steady in joy and sorrow, and forgiving—such a person is deeply dear.
starter_verse_pack.daily_reflection: What would compassion look like in one small interaction today?
starter_verse_pack.tiny_practice: Offer one quiet act of kindness today without needing recognition.

starter_verse_pack.sanskrit: तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत। तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम्।।18.62।।
starter_verse_pack.transliteration: tam eva śaraṇaṁ gaccha sarva-bhāvena bhārata; tat-prasādāt parāṁ śāntiṁ sthānaṁ prāpsyasi śāśvatam.
starter_verse_pack.translation_plain: Take refuge in Him with your whole being. By His grace you shall find supreme peace and the lasting state.
starter_verse_pack.daily_reflection: What am I still holding back from trust?
starter_verse_pack.tiny_practice: In one quiet moment today, inwardly hand one burden over instead of tightening around it.

starter_verse_pack.sanskrit: सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज। अहं त्वां सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः।।18.66।।
starter_verse_pack.transliteration: sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṁ śaraṇaṁ vraja; ahaṁ tvāṁ sarva-pāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ.
starter_verse_pack.translation_plain: Abandon all limited supports and take refuge in Me alone. I will free you; do not grieve.
starter_verse_pack.daily_reflection: What fear would soften if I truly believed I did not have to carry everything alone?
starter_verse_pack.tiny_practice: End the day by naming one worry and consciously releasing it.
